summary.headline: Two Methods of Necromantic Images
summary.text: A critique of two methods of necromantic images: fumigation and astrological timing by the twenty-eight lunar mansions, day and night hours, and named days; and inscription of magical characters invoking Solomon’s rings and Almandal, Muhameth, Raziel, spirits, signs, planets, angels, and triplicities.
